title: A state transition inside a slot-keyed virtual list must be keyed by its row
rule: When you add a CSS transition (or animation) that runs on a state change of an element inside a virtualized list whose rows are keyed by slot (FontList, FontWaterfall: `:key="item.slot"`, rows recycled on scroll and on new results), key that element by its row (`:key="item.row.key"`) or otherwise start the transition only when the same row's state changes. A recycled slot otherwise patches the same element from the previous row's state to the new one, so a search or a scroll animates. Test it in e2e on the List and Waterfall views with a non-default state in the data (e.g. `?mockActive=1`), record the transitions during a search that moves that row to another slot, and check the test fails without the key.
rationale: E46.4 (#481): the activation dot's new scale transition fired on recycled List and Waterfall rows during search and scroll, breaking 'nothing animates in search results'; the only no-motion test ran on the Grid (keyed by row) with no active faces.
